reasons.plausibility: Using high-pressure SPS to reduce phase separation and void formation by enhancing densification is well-supported by known mechanisms and aligns with standard practices for W–Cu composite fabrication, though the extent of improved properties requires careful validation.
reasons.testability: The proposed head-to-head comparison of high-pressure SPS versus conventional sintering with direct measurements of microstructure and thermal conductivity under relevant conditions is both clear and decisive.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses a known limitation of W–Cu joints and provides a feasible intervention and a clear experimental plan that can guide future research on improving thermal performance and radiation resistance.
